home.heroSubtitle: Bilingual courses built for dental college students — taught by practicing clinicians and academics.
home.heroNote: No fees. Apply to any course and start learning as soon as you're approved.
home.feature1Desc: Every course is available in Arabic and English with full right-to-left support.
home.feature2Desc: Lectures and PDFs are watermarked with your identity to keep material secure.
home.feature3Desc: Track your progress, take quizzes, and revisit lectures anytime.
home.howSubtitle: Getting into a course takes three simple steps.
home.step1Desc: Browse the catalog and open any course that fits your studies.
home.step2Desc: Send a request — the instructor or our team reviews and approves it.
home.step3Desc: Once approved, the course unlocks in your dashboard right away.
